2610.11889.title: Evaluating Exact Output and Checkpoint-State Prediction in Real Programs
2610.11889.paper_summary: We present a benchmark for predicting final output and checkpoint state from source and input alone. It extends CRUXEval-style output prediction with paired shorter- and longer-trace inputs and checkpoints inside and after a loop. The benchmark contains 400 cases from 371 Python and C++ programs, evaluated under seven settings from four model families without tools or code execution. Of 11,200 planned predictions, 11,151 produced gradable responses. Reasoning-enabled settings outperform their off counterparts by 33.1 to 55.2 percentage points on completed responses. The strongest setting scores 93.0% on shorter-trace final output, 77.0% on longer-trace final output, and 65.5% and 63.5% on the two state tasks; these scores also hold when missing responses count as wrong. Across 2,397 matched Python comparisons with identical source, changing to the longer-trace input yields 528 correct-to-wrong changes and 147 reversals. Source-clustered analyses preserve this accuracy gap, while adjusted Python models give no evidence of a positive incremental association between cumulative state load and error. Changed inputs and checkpoint tasks alter several factors together, so the gaps do not isolate trace length or an internal state-tracking mechanism. The benchmark exposes errors hidden by short-output scores alone.
2610.11889.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個基準，僅根據源代碼和輸入來預測最終輸出和檢查點狀態。它擴展了CRUXEval風格的輸出預測，包含配對的短追蹤和長追蹤輸入，以及循環內部和之後的檢查點。該基準包含來自371個Python和C++程序的400個案例，在四個模型系列的七個設置下進行評估，未使用工具或代碼執行。在11,200個計劃的預測中，11,151個產生了可評分的回應。啟用推理的設置在完成的回應上比其對應的非推理設置高出33.1到55.2個百分點。最強的設置在短追蹤最終輸出上得分93.0%，在長追蹤最終輸出上得分77.0%，在兩個狀態任務上分別得分65.5%和63.5%；這些分數在缺失回應被計算為錯誤時也保持不變。在2,397個源代碼相同的Python比較中，改為長追蹤輸入產生528個正確轉為錯誤的變化和147個反轉。源聚類分析保留了這一準確性差距，而調整後的Python模型則未顯示累積狀態負載與錯誤之間存在正增量關聯的證據。改變的輸入和檢查點任務共同改變了幾個因素，因此這些差距並未孤立追蹤長度或內部狀態跟踪機制。該基準揭示了僅由短輸出分數隱藏的錯誤。
